rationale: The four views read primarily as a shallow, elongated podium with several thin fin-like pieces rather than a convincing slender upper mass. The intended podium-to-tower gesture is not legible from the front or opposite views, and the top view shows multiple pieces converging without a clean primary anchor. There is no meaningful public void, courtyard, or undercut. The form avoids stair-step massing, but its fragmented surface pieces and apparent intersections weaken overall integrity. It only weakly resonates with the podium-and-tower precedents and should be rejected at this stage.
warnings: The dominant upper mass is too low and visually insubstantial to read as a tower.
The massing is not coherent as a podium-plus-slender-mass composition across all four views.
Several fin-like volumes appear to overlap or collide rather than resolve into one integrated solid.
No meaningful void or open-ground logic is visible.
